# Entry Level Software Developer Resume Templates - ATS Optimized

Professional resume templates for entry-level software developers. Choose from technical specialist, academic, or ATS-optimized formats. Perfect for bootcamp grads and CS new grads.

Each resume has been vetted by recruiters, is optimized to pass ATS and recruitment software, and is downloadable/editable for free.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Get clear answers to your questions, so you can focus on what matters—acing your interviews with confidence.

Entry Level Software Developers write code, debug applications, and assist in building software products under senior developer guidance. They work with programming languages like Python, JavaScript, or Java to create web applications, mobile apps, or backend systems. Daily tasks include coding new features, fixing bugs, writing tests, and participating in code reviews to improve their technical skills.

## Know What They'll Ask About Your Resume

Know exactly what questions your background will trigger in interviews. Start telling your story with confidence.
